children: Overview
Precious metals royalty firm's Q3 revenue rose 84% yr/yr, slightly missing analyst expectations
Company achieved record operating cash flow and gold equivalent ounce sales
Royal Gold repurchased $49 mln in shares and fully repaid outstanding debt after quarter end
Outlook
Royal Gold raises 2026 sales guidance for other metals to $53–$56 mln from $34–$38 mln
Company expects 2026 gold, silver, and copper sales to meet or exceed top end of guidance
Company maintains 2026 guidance for DD&A expense at $339–$379 mln and effective tax rate at 17–22%
Result Drivers
HIGHER METAL PRICES - Co said increased average prices for gold, silver and copper contributed to higher revenue
NEW STREAMS AND ASSETS - Revenue benefited from new sales from the Kansanshi stream and Sandstorm and Horizon assets
INCREASED SALES AT KEY MINES - Higher sales at Andacollo, Mount Milligan, Pueblo Viejo, and Xavantina supported revenue growth
